content: Apply local code changes to the running setup: (1) cargo build --release -p fabro-cli (2) install -m 755 target/release/fabro ~/.fabro/bin/fabro — CLI in ~/.fabro/bin is never auto-refreshed (3) cargo dev docker-build --arch amd64 --tag ghcr.io/fabro-sh/fabro:local (4) docker compose up -d. Compose (repo docker-compose.yaml) references ghcr.io/fabro-sh/fabro:${FABRO_VERSION:-nightly}; repo .env pins FABRO_VERSION=local so compose uses the locally built image instead of the pulled nightly. A plain restart does NOT apply code changes — the image rebuild is required. /storage volume persists server data and dev-token across restarts. Verified 2026-08-21 with ba07e47.

Update loop for feature work: feature branch (feat/...) carries code, lab branch (denkhaus-lab) carries the config under test (.fabro/Dockerfile.mise + project.toml image.dockerfile); watch branch state before fabro run — the run clones the CHECKED-OUT branch, not the pushed one. Cold build surfaces as 'building fabro-runner-<sha12>...' in CLI output; verify reuse via absence of snapshot.creating in run events.
